title: Senior consultant Data sciences
description:
We are looking for a Senior Consultant in Data Sciences with AWS AI/ML expertise, specifically focusing on Agentic AI solutions within the Healthcare and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) sectors. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable, responsible AI systems and collaborating with diverse teams to solve complex business challenges.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Seven or more years of experience in AI/ML, Data Science, or AI Engineering.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience building Agentic AI solutions on AWS.
* Proficiency with Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, Strands, and related AWS AI services.
* Strong understanding of classical AI/ML, Deep Learning, and Generative AI models.
* Comprehensive knowledge of NLP, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
* Experience designing and implementing multi-agent or autonomous AI workflows.
* Foundational understanding of evaluation, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI practices.
* Professional experience within the Healthcare or Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) industries.
* Ability to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions through effective communication with clients and technical teams.

title: TECHNICAL LEAD - INTELLIGENT AUTOMATION
description:
**Senior Python API & GenAI Backend Engineer (5–10 Years Experience)**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled
**Senior Python API & GenAI Backend Engineer**
with 5–10 years of experience in backend development, API engineering, and Generative AI solution development. The ideal candidate should be a strong hands-on developer with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of designing, developing, and leading enterprise-grade AI-powered solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable backend applications, APIs, and microservices using Python.
* Lead end-to-end implementation of GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using modern AI frameworks.
* Develop AI agents and workflows using LangChain/LangGraph.
* Integrate vector databases and implement semantic search capabilities.
* Design secure, scalable, and high-performance solutions on Azure or AWS.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

**Required Skills**

* **5–10 years of strong hands-on Python development experience**
* Experience building and deploying
  **GenAI / Agentic AI solutions**
* Expertise in
  **RAG, LangChain/ LangGraph**
* Hands-on experience with
  **Vector Databases**
  (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Milvus, etc.)
* Experience with
  **Azure AI Foundry**
  and/or
  **AWS Bedrock**
* Strong experience in
  **REST API Development & Integration**
* Experience with
  **SQL/NoSQL databases**
* Familiarity with
  **Docker, CI/CD, Git, and Cloud-native development**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
